provenance: IBM AMLworld HI-Small (Altman et al., Kaggle ealtman2019/ibm-transactions-for-anti-money-laundering-aml, CDLA-Sharing-1.0). The corpus is entirely SYNTHETIC by IBM's own statement -- generated by a multi-agent virtual world, not real customer data. An earlier revision of this line opened with the word 'real' and then said synthetic in its next sentence; what is real is the provenance, not the transactions. These are unmodified rows of the published corpus, carrying the engineered features finance_aml.gbm was actually trained on, unlike the 8-feature PaySim sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline.

input.layout: samples[i] is one row of the 32 features below

expected.note: Stratified to contain positives -- AMLworld's real prevalence is ~1 in 981, so an unstratified draw would be all-negative and accuracy would be vacuous.
